judgment: It is a little good to set out.
image: So the noble one makes the many matters clear,
and does not dare settle lawsuits.
lines: then leaves the cart and goes on foot.
They are not raiders, but suitors.
a roll of silk, small, so small.
Shame, but in the end: good.

notes.L4: 翰如 flying/swift; the suitors refrain from hexagram 3 kept in the same words.
